RPB는 중력가속도가 아닌 고속 원심 가속도를 이용 함으로써 물질 전달 계수를 크게 높여 장치의 크기를 획기적으로 줄일 수 있는 장점을 가지 고 있습니다. • Rotating Packed Bed Although the chemical absorption-based post-combustion carbon capture (PCCC) process is the most matured and extensively adopted worldwide, a large contactor volume with high capital cost is required due to the limited mass transfer rate in conventional columns. items.product: MKE Polymer was established in 2022 at Daedeok Technovalley, the birthplace of science and engineering technology. Myung-ho Kim Ph.D., Professor, the CEO, has been conducting research in the field of extrusion processes since 1987, and is a global authority in three fields of extrusion technology: single-screw extruder technology, twin-screw extruder technology, and die technology. Using his technical expertise, he has successfully carried out various projects in the fields of new material process development and process improvement, such as plastic processing, battery coating process, and electrical and electronic material development with leading global companies. MKE, the parent company, has been attracting attention from the industry by commercializing rheological property measurement equipment and material process evaluation equipment one after another, starting with the localization of a torque rheometer in 2011, the development of laboratory compounding equipment in 2015, and the first localization of a capillary rheometer in 2019. In particular, the screw rheometer, which was released for the first time in the world, has been patented in 21 countries around the world, including the United States and Europe, and Received the KIPO Commissioner Award in 2024. Screw rheometers are capable of accurately measuring viscosity and viscoelasticity of various materials, providing innovative rheological measurement solutions in the fields of composite polymers, rPlastics, batteries, and pharmaceuticals. MKE Polymer has further developed the core technology of the parent company, polymer rheology measurement technology, and has completed the development of the DMC (Digital Material Center) that can measure the three properties required for injection molding digital twins. It also sells a hot stage microscope specialized in polymer morphology analysis and an automatic data acquisition system required for laboratory automation. In particular, starting from 2024, it will develop the RheoStastics technique utilizing this differentiated rheology measurement technology and create innovative solutions in the field of mechanical recycling of plastics, rPlastic Upcycling. Changing the industrial paradigm from the existing new material-based plastic product production (Oil-based plastics) to the production of recyclable-based plastic products (Plastic-based plastics) is an issue that the whole world is facing in the era of the carbon-cycle economy. By combining the advanced rheology and processing technology that MKE and MKE Polymer Ltd. have accumulated so far, it aims to secure the production technology of recycled material products through mechanical recycling and lead the innovation of the Korean plastic up-cycling field. (Foundry in rPlastics Up-cycling)
